title: Own-Provider Visit Re-Rating Reversal
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Membership — claims operations computation standard**

## 1. The standard

1.1 **Re-rating window.** The re-rating window is the 12 re-rating window months counted back from the review date (the date the re-rating is worked out). A service date counts as inside the window when it lies fewer than 12 whole months before the review date.

1.2 **Re-rating batch.** The re-rating batch is every paid specialist visit claim whose service date falls in the re-rating window and whose billing provider is the member's current primary care provider — the provider of the member's active assignment in the Primary Care Provider Assignment records.

1.3 **Batch reversal.** Each batch visit is re-rated at the category's primary care visit copay. The batch reversal is the total of the copays booked on the batch claims less the total of the re-rated copays (the number of batch visits multiplied by the re-rated copay), rounded half up to the cent. For the rounding, 0.0001 cent is added to the figure before it is rounded, so an amount lying on a half cent is always rounded upward.

## 2. The quantities, one by one

| Quantity | Where it is read | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| Review date | The day of handling | The date from which the window is counted back |
| Re-rating window | Calendar | Service dates fewer than 12 whole months before the review date |
| Batch claims | Claim ledger | Paid claims in the specialist visit copay category, in the window, billed by the current primary care provider |
| Copays booked | Claim ledger | The member cost share on each batch claim, added together |
| Re-rated copay | The category's copay schedule | The category's primary care visit copay, for each batch visit |
| Batch reversal | Result | Copays booked less re-rated copays, rounded half up to the cent |

A paid specialist visit claim billed by any other provider, a denied claim, and a claim whose service date lies 12 or more whole months before the review date are not batch claims.

## 3. Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

The inputs below are chosen for illustration only; they are not company figures and describe no member.

- Hypothetical category copays: primary care visit copay 2.00; specialist visit copay 3.00.
- The claim ledger shows four paid specialist visit claims billed by the member's current primary care provider, with service dates 1, 4, 7 and 13 whole months before the review date, each booked with a copay of 3.00.

| Step of the definition | Figure |
|---|---|
| Claims in the window (fewer than 12 whole months) | 3 (the claim 13 months back is outside) |
| Copays booked on the batch | 9.00 |
| Re-rated copays: 3 visits at 2.00 | 6.00 |
| Batch reversal: 9.00 less 6.00, rounded half up | 3.00 |

## 4. Boundary of the window (hypothetical dates)

- A service date 11 whole months and 30 days before the review date is fewer than 12 whole months back: inside the window.
- A service date exactly 12 whole months before the review date is not fewer than 12 whole months back: outside the window.
